overview: You looked at the three deposition sheets and added nothing to them. On the older leaf the margin still said York was angry, and the messenger was still only a mark. The prison was not begun. The end was not begun. Field's Holinshed stayed shut.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the margin, and did not begin the prison or the end.

important_dates.meaning: The mark, still in the margin
